name: shared control: PII stored at rest without encryption
note: The SAME workload, the SAME FAIR triples, priced against BOTH institutions. `behind` is the UNCAGED state: the workload stores PII on a volume that is not encrypted at rest and it is running. Triples are (min, mode, max); LEF = loss events/year, LM = GBP/event. Nothing here is institution-specific -- the only thing that differs across driftwood and ludlow is the risk-appetite tolerance band each party SIGNS on its own party.yaml (`appetite.tolerance`, ADR-0021). That band alone selects a different RUNG on the cage ladder for the same number. Eco-system ticket 89 replaced the v1 `warn`/`deny` pair with this single `behind` block: `deny` was a state of the world in which admission blocked the workload, and there is no such state any more -- nothing is denied, and a workload that does not fit its cage does not run (owner, 2026-09-02, ticket 75 Q5).
